title: CLI crashes on startup when ran inside a Git repository and MacOS seatbelt is enabled

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear and actionable bug report, complete with reproduction steps, environment details (macOS, sandbox enabled), and /about client information demonstrating a startup crash inside Git repositories.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Fixing this bug requires handling platform-specific macOS seatbelt (sandbox-exec) restrictions, modifying sandbox policy parameters in packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.ts, and ensuring safe interactions with Git initialization and worktree settings across packages/cli and packages/core.

summary.problem: Gemini CLI crashes on startup when executed inside a Git repository with macOS Seatbelt sandbox enabled.
summary.root_cause: When macOS seatbelt (sandbox-exec) is enabled, file write and directory access permissions are strictly limited by sandbox profile definitions. Git operations on startup (such as GitService initializing a shadow repository or worktree settings resolution) trigger file system operations to paths restricted under the seatbelt policy, causing permission denials and startup crashes.
summary.context: The macOS seatbelt configuration in sandbox.ts uses .sb profile files (e.g., sandbox-macos-permissive-open.sb) that define allowed write paths like TARGET_DIR, TMP_DIR, CACHE_DIR, and ~/.gemini. Starting the CLI inside a Git repository causes Git utilities (simple-git, execa('git', ...)) to interact with repository configuration, locks, or root discovery paths that require explicit permission under seatbelt policies.

steps: Inspect seatbelt profiles in packages/cli/src/utils/ to identify missing allowed paths or permissions required for Git operations inside repositories.
Update packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.ts to pass appropriate directory flags and environment variables to sandbox-exec for Git repository boundaries.
Ensure GitService initialization and worktree resolution in packages/core handle seatbelt sandbox restrictions gracefully without crashing.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Gemini CLI starts up successfully without crashing when executed inside a Git repository with macOS Seatbelt sandbox enabled.
verification_steps: Add unit test cases in packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.test.ts to verify sandbox-exec command generation when running within a Git repository.
Run 'npx vitest run packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.test.ts' to ensure all sandbox tests pass.
